description: This file defines database connection management classes and functions for the WACT_DB package, including configuration, connection handling, and query factory methods.

classes.name: DBC_ConnectionConfiguration
classes.description: Handles database connection configuration options and generates Data Source Names (DSN).

classes.name: DBC
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing a single database connection, including creating records, executing queries, and retrieving data.

methods.name: getCurrentConnection
methods.description: Returns the current database connection object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the current database connection if it exists.

methods.name: NewRecord
methods.description: Creates a new database record object.

methods.name: NewRecordSet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple records based on a SQL query.

methods.name: NewPagedRecordSet
methods.description: Retrieves paged records based on a SQL query.

methods.name: getOneColumnArray
methods.description: Returns an array of values from the first column of a query result.

methods.name: getTwoColumnArray
methods.description: Returns an associative array from a query with first column as key and second as value.

methods.name: FindRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single record based on a query.

methods.name: getOneValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single value from a query.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a query that does not return a cursor.

methods.name: makeLiteral
methods.description: Converts a PHP value into an SQL literal.
